messages:
Jules (Growth): Quick sync: webinar is global next Wed. Need plan for replay access across timezones + captions in ENG/ESP. Also want short clips for APAC socials. Can we finalize?
Kei (Events): Suggested: live session gated by region for first 48h (EMEA/APAC/NA windows) then unified public release. Keeps regional follow-ups tidy. Thoughts?
Ravi (Content): For captions, we can auto-gen ENG then human-review ESP for key clips only. Full Spanish transcript by EOD+2.
Tess (Customer Ops): Regional gating might confuse registrants if links change. Can we keep same URL but show a region-specific overlay explaining availability?
Sam (Design): Yep. Same URL, different CTA states: "Replay available now" / "Available at 10am GMT". I'll prepare small snackbar style banner.
Leo (Marketing Ops): Tech notes: keep one replay page + feature-flagged access. Zap rules: register -> tag with region -> post-event send localized email. Use Accept-Language header for language fallback.
Jules (Growth): Email copy variants: EN/ES. Subject EN: "Replay now available". Subject ES: "Repetición disponible". Ravi will provide quick ES copy.
Ravi (Content): Will do 2-line ES subject + 3 bullet localized benefits. ETA: today 3pm PT.
ReplayBot: Recording uploaded: size 4.2GB. Transcripts (auto-EN) available. Processing: Spanish ASR+human-review queued.
Tess (Customer Ops): For enterprise accounts, keep replay gated indefinitely behind account verification. Add tag: enterprise-replay-hold.
Kei (Events): Good call. Also set retention: public replay available for 90 days, enterprise copies stored 1yr. @Leo confirm storage policy?
Leo (Marketing Ops): Confirmed. Public TTL: 90 days. Enterprise archive: 365 days. We'll reflect that in the confirmation email.
Sam (Design): Clips: need 3 x 60s hero clips and 4 x 30s social cuts optimized for IG/LinkedIn. Also provide subtitles burnt-in for socials.
Ravi (Content): I'll timestamp key moments; can someone drop start/end markers?
Jules (Growth): I'll flag 3 moments live. Tess will post markers in #event-live.
Kei (Events): Accessibility: burn-in captions for social, separate VTT for player, offer downloadable transcript (EN/ES). Also ensure playback speeds available.
ReplayBot: Clips task queued (auto-highlights) -> will post candidate timestamps in 30m.
analytics-bot: I'll extract timezone-based registrant distribution and predicted live attendance windows. Posting numbers in 1h.
Leo (Marketing Ops): Last ops: confirmation email must include: consent checkbox for clip use, region/timezone note, storage TTL, and link to privacy policy. Add utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=latency-global-2028.
Jules (Growth): Thanks. If all clear, Keis, merge overlay assets by 6pm PT and Sam to push socials brief by EOD. We'll reconvene after dry run for final timing. :rocket:
